title: Refining a field changes only the parameters the refinement sets
rule: Refining an existing field overrides the parameters the refinement sets and keeps the others.

provisional.question: The documentation's example refines hidden on a dimension that sets nothing else, so it does not show what happens to the parameters a field refinement leaves unset. When a refinement sets only label on a dimension, does the dimension keep its type and sql?

citations.quote: in most cases a refinement will override the original settings of an object
The last refinement takes precedence, so hidden: no is applied and the dimension will be displayed in the final view.

rationale: A refinement overrides the settings it contains. The case reads that as overriding only the parameters the refinement sets, so the field keeps the others; the documentation's example does not show it.
